title: Responsible corporate officer as "person".
bodyText: For the purpose of this chapter, the term "person" means, in addition to the definition contained in section 342D-1, any responsible corporate officer.
bodyHtml: [§342D-37]  Responsible corporate officer as "person".  For the purpose of this chapter, the term "person" means, in addition to the definition contained in section 342D-1, any responsible corporate officer. [L 1989, c 212, pt of §2]
